Completion evidence for c87afedba88b14c5fd43e1540d845787014632ed (Gerrit 1553):

- c03 legacy filter continuity: `request.py` still parses `--filter-local-ids`; `reconcile.py` keeps `filter_local_ids` as the post-differ write filter. `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_filter.py` pins accepted parsing and post-filter behavior, while `test_bridge_selection_scope_heldout.py` proves canonical selection narrows differ inputs instead.
- c05 library/MCP continuity: `src/rebar/_lib_ops.py:92` retains `reconcile(mode="dry-run")`; `src/rebar/_mcp_reads.py:286` retains the MCP `reconcile` tool and delegates to the library facade. `tests/interfaces/facades/test_library.py` and `tests/interfaces/facades/test_mcp.py` pass, including dry-run/read-only and mode-gate behavior.
- c06 workflow vocabulary and rollback mapping: `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml:265-269` retains reconcile-check and maps dry-run/bootstrap-strict/bootstrap-throttle/live to preview/sync/10/100/live. `test_bridge_primary_workflow_heldout.py` and `test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py` pin every mapping and prior exit handling.
- c07 automated callers: both pressure-test scripts invoke canonical sync plus `--only` for bounded probes, while their reconcile-check diagnostic remains legacy by design. `_dc_support.py` retains `run_reconcile` and adds `run_bridge`; `test_reconcile_pass.py` and `test_user_guide_commands.py` use the canonical helper. Existing compatibility consumers remain unchanged.
- c08 real-entrypoint parity: `test_bridge_cli_heldout.py`, `test_bridge_request_heldout.py`, `test_bridge_selection_heldout.py`, `test_bridge_selection_scope_heldout.py`, and `test_bridge_cap_heldout.py` cover real CLI/engine defaults, gates, pause, invalid input, selection, caps, output and mutation boundaries.
- c09 help vocabulary: `src/rebar/_cli/help/bridge.txt` and `overview.txt` lead with preview/sync; `test_bridge_help_avoids_internal_vocabulary_and_numeric_exit_codes` pins the public wording.
- c10 docs/generated reference: `docs/user-guide.md`, `cli-reference.md`, `jira-sync-setup.md`, and `release-notes.md` lead with preview/sync and explicitly preserve legacy defaults. `test_gen_cli_reference.py` passes. ADR 0092 is reserved by `.numbers/0092`, indexed in generated `docs/adr/README.md`, and both ADR drift checks pass.
- c11 environment continuity: legacy CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, external-DC helper and older workflow routes all remain present and tested; ADR 0092 records the expand-contract decision.

Focused completion proof after merge: 140 passed in 20.61s across the eleven cited compatibility/bridge/help/workflow suites. CI run 31283137439 passed all 15 jobs, including all Python versions, ADR bijection/index drift, lint, typecheck, packaging and default/integration suites. Gerrit recorded LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 and zero unresolved comments before merge.
